content: Human-labeling session — build-engineer-rebuild-after-loss:hard seed 1. Objective: You inherit a full base with $500 reserve. TWO enemy heavy tanks sit beside your low-HP Power Plant and will destroy it on the opening turn, then linger to revisit a fresh plant placed back in the strike lane. Your base may sit in the NORTH or SOUTH band depending on seed, so the rebuild cell must be derived from the Construction Yard's actual position. Rebuild the Power Plant and keep your Refinery within about 30 turns.
